implication: The hook is notifications only; no-session signup and confirmation callback must not queue it or persist a password. Welcome/admin/Telegram notifications from this legacy branch are omitted for confirmation-required signup.

vk.observedContract: UserInfoResult.user is Partial<UserData>; email string, no email_verified ownership assertion in the declared contract
vk.conclusion: Email ownership guarantees not established; email equality is not permission to bind an existing account
vk.policy: Only an existing matching public.users.vk_id permits existing-account OTP; unlinked/conflicting accounts fail closed
vk.legacyPartialAccounts: No automatic repair based on email or fallback address; existing email login or separately verified recovery required
